scripts.build: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL:-${POSTGRES_URL:-${NEON_POSTGRES_URL:-${NEON_POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL:-${NEON_DATABASE_URL:-${NEON_URL:-}}}}}}}"; if [ -n "${DATABASE_URL:-}" ]; then prisma migrate deploy; fi; fi; prisma generate && next build
